letter.subject: Civil Works Project Officer (temporary full time to April 2027)
paragraphs: Please accept my application for the Civil Works Project Officer role in Yarra's Development and Civil Engineering team. Supervising reinstatement works on Council roads and footpaths and checking them against Council's specifications is the kind of site role I am looking for.

Site supervision and inspections: from 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring, and escalated issues that needed corrective action. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I assisted with inspections and quality checks and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers to sort out site issues.

Scoping and standards: in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in Australia, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards, and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019).

Planning and communication: on site I planned each day's work, kept progress and material records and kept clients and stakeholders up to date. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I have not worked for a council or on Australian road reserves yet, so I would be learning Yarra's Road Management Plan and permit processes.
I have attached my resume and would welcome the chance to talk about the role.

checklist: Search Gmail in:anywhere for Yarra City Council and Civil Works Project Officer before applying (Gmail was not reachable on this tick)
Read the Position Description PDF on the PageUp page and check the cover letter covers its Key Selection Criteria
Apply at https://careers.pageuppeople.com/817/cw/en/job/496994/civil-works-project-officer (closes 22 Nov 2026 11:55pm) with the resume and one page cover letter
Police check required before start; Marc to confirm salary and start date himself
